01 / THE THREAD

A little context

Own the path from request to production.

My work spans APIs, asynchronous processing, AI agents, security and production support.

I designed and owned five production REST APIs for a multi-tenant B2B platform and contributed to more than 40 APIs.

I also built event-driven workflows and a Node.js agentic AI system, then monitored, debugged and improved them in production.

02 / SELECTED SYSTEMS

What I've shipped

APIs, agentic AI and reliable workflows.

Full Stack Software Engineer at Fragmatic Technologies · Apr 2024 – Present

01

Backend / REST APIs

Production APIs with faster database queries.

Designed and owned five REST APIs for a multi-tenant B2B platform. Work included authentication, validation, business logic, Sequelize and PostgreSQL, deployment and production support. Optimized listing queries from 30–40 seconds to 3–8 seconds.

  • Node.js
  • REST APIs
  • Sequelize · PostgreSQL

02

Applied AI / Security

An agent that can use tools with permission.

Built a Node.js agentic AI system end to end. It supports tool calling, planning, multi-step execution, subagents, conversation state, structured outputs, streaming and human approval for changes. Added role-based authorization and audit logging. Built a provider-agnostic service for OpenAI, Gemini and Groq, with fallback, retries and rate-limit handling. Caching and API/LLM tuning cut typical runs from 30–60 seconds to 6–18 seconds.

  • Agentic AI
  • Tool calling · subagents
  • RBAC · audit logging

03

Infrastructure / Reliability

Async workflows built to handle failures.

Used Redis, Bull, AWS SQS, Lambda and API Gateway for asynchronous processing, retries, caching and TTL-based work. Debugged production failures with CloudWatch and application logs. Improved an HTML personalization pipeline for 10K–35K character pages from 30–50 seconds to 6–12 seconds.

  • Redis · Bull
  • AWS SQS · Lambda
  • Retries · TTL · caching

03 / AFTER HOURS

The systems lab

A job scheduler I built from scratch.

A separate project for learning how distributed jobs behave.

It uses Redis for queueing and PostgreSQL for job state. It supports scheduled execution, concurrent workers, retries, idempotency and failure recovery.
